name: Display Mode Switcher
description: Rule-based entity display-mode switching at render time via pluggable condition plugins, with correct cache metadata propagation.
project_description: Display Mode Switcher swaps an entity's display (view) mode at render time based on configurable rules and condition plugins, without template overrides or custom code. You define rules that name a target entity type (and optionally bundle), a source display mode that triggers evaluation, a target display mode to switch to, a weight for ordering, and zero or more condition plugins. At render time the module evaluates matching rules in ascending weight order; the first rule whose conditions all pass wins and its target mode is used, otherwise the source mode is kept. The classic use case is a paywall (anonymous visitors see a teaser mode, subscribers see the full mode), but any audience- or context-dependent field layout fits. Rules are configuration entities (fully exportable). Cache tags, contexts, and max-age from every evaluated condition are merged into the render array so Drupal's render cache stays correct. A custom condition plugin manager exposes the full standard Drupal condition library plus module-specific plugins placed in Plugin/DisplayModeSwitcherCondition/.
